Name: MoveFoldersProse
Directions: Move everything from the Straight Fixes, Resolution Fixes, and Aesthetic Improvements folders to your Override.

Name: PatcherProse
Directions: Run the installer, then move the files from the patch to your override.

Name: DeleteBeforeMoveProse
Directions: Make sure to delete LSI_win01.tpc and LSI_box01.tpc **before** moving to override.

Name: BeforeMovingDeleteProse
Directions: Before moving the files to the override folder, be sure to delete the following: PFBI01 through PFBI04, and PMBI01 through PMBI04.

Name: RerunPatcherProse
Directions: Install the main mod, then re-run the patcher and select the K1CP compatibility install option and install it as well, if using K1CP.

Name: MoveExceptProse
Directions: The file has the wrong readme; move all the files in the Creatures folder, except for the readme and Gizka.jpg (any .jpg/.png files are always previews and can be deleted), to the override.

Name: Conditional
Directions: Delete old.tga from override, and if also using Extra Textures, additionally delete extra.tga from override.

Name: NamedCleanList
Directions: Delete the files listed in cleanlist_k1.txt for your installed mods before running the patcher.

Name: BareCleanList
Directions: Before installing, delete any files listed in the cleanlist that correspond to mods you already have installed.

Name: UnknownAction
Directions: Download the archive using a browser.

Name: Commentary
Directions: Bear in mind this is normal.

Name: Range
Directions: Delete file01.tga through file10.tga before moving the files.

Name: Rename
Directions: Rename the file old.tga to new.tga.

Name: CopyRename
Directions: Make a copy of old.tga and rename it to new.tga.

Name: Extract
Directions: Extract the mod to your mod directory.

Name: Movies
Directions: Move the movie files to your Movies folder.

Name: DownloadOptions
DownloadInstructions: I recommend the High Resolution version. Choose the Blue variant.

Name: Overwrite
Directions: Delete old.tga from override and do not overwrite.

Name: Unsafe
Directions: Move everything from the ../../outside folder to your Override.
